name: Tsuma o Tanpo ni
source:
The shop is deep in debt.
Between the bills, the mortgage, and employee wages things are bad.
You took money from a lender named "Mr. Jackson" to survive
and breaking even on the shop seems within reach, but debt snowballs.
There's just no money. There's no money. It can't be helped.
But you can't just give up! You have one last-ditch option.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ172485.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这家商店负债累累。
在账单、抵押贷款和员工工资之间，情况很糟糕。
你从一个名叫“杰克逊先生”的贷方那里拿钱来生存
商店的收支平衡似乎触手可及，但债务却像滚雪球一样越滚越大。
只是没有钱。没钱了。这是没办法的事。
但你不能就这么放弃！你还有最后一搏的选择。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ172485.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
